results.title: Nigeria Invites Investors for Morocco-Nigeria Gas Pipeline Project
results.snippet:
The Nigeria-Morocco Gas Pipeline, also known as the African Atlantic Gas Pipeline, is a mega-project. It is jointly led by NNPC and Morocco’s National Office of Hydrocarbons and Mines (ONHYM).

The project seeks to transport over 30 billion cubic meters of natural gas annually to Morocco through 13 Atlantic coastal countries.
